title: Integrality of Lipschitz push-forwards and of products with [[0,1]] for integer multiplicity currents (Simon 6.3.3–3.9; parent Part B)
statement: Assume, as hypotheses of the statement, (VO) the frozen type of Submission.dtc_vanish_off_support: for all P, n, U, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0; (MR) the frozen type of Submission.cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure: for U open and an IMRep R representing T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), M_W(T) = R.measure(W) for every open W; (IMC) the frozen type of Submission.cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub: (a) for U open and Borel M ⊆ M' ⊆ U with Hⁿ(M' ∩ K) < ∞ for compact K ⊆ U, for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M the approximate tangent spaces of M and M' at x coincide; (b) for U open, an IMRep R and Borel E, the triple (R.carrier ∩ E, R.mult, R.orient) is an IMRep representing some current; (c) for U open, A − B is integer multiplicity when A and B are; (d) |R.orient(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for Hⁿ-a.e. x in the carrier of any IMRep R; and (IMS) the exact frozen type of Submission.cmcdt_im_series, which itself assumes (VO), (MR), (IMC) and then asserts: for all P, k and W : ℕ → 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) with Σ_i M(W_i) < ∞ there is S ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) with S(ω) = Σ_i W_i(ω) (HasSum) for every ω, M(S) ≤ Σ_i M(W_i), spt S ⊆ closure ⋃_i spt W_i, and S integer multiplicity if every W_i is. (These are the exact frozen Lean types, written as antecedents.) Currents are on univ; write ι(t, x) := (t, x_1, …, x_N) ∈ ℝ^{N+1} (Lean WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) and e₀ := (1, 0, …, 0) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1). Then: (I) for all N, N', k ∈ ℕ, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, Λ-Lipschitz F : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}, integer multiplicity X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N) with compact support and M(X) < ∞, and S ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^{N'}): if there are C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)) Λ-Lipschitz maps F_j : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} (j ∈ ℕ) converging to F uniformly on ℝ^N such that for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N'}) there are test forms η_j ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^N), each equal to F_j^#ω (x ↦ ω(F_j(x)) ∘ DF_j(x)) on some open set containing spt X, with X(η_j) → S(ω), then S is integer multiplicity; (II) for all N, k ∈ ℕ, integer multiplicity X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N) with compact support and M(X) < ∞, and C ∈ 𝒟_{k+2}(ℝ^{N+1}): if for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+2}(ℝ^{N+1}) there is η ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^N) with η(x)(v_1, …, v_{k+1}) = ∫_0^1 ω(ι(t, x))(e₀, ι(0, v_1), …, ι(0, v_{k+1})) dt for all x and v and C(ω) = X(η), then C is integer multiplicity.
